title: Hsinchu City Launches Accessible and Gender-Friendly Public Bus Services to Enhance Safety and Inclusivity
summary: The Hsinchu City Government held an event at the Hsinchu Bus Company's Niuwu repair workshop to promote wheelchair boarding assistance and anti‑sexual harassment protocols for bus drivers, in collaboration with five local bus operators and disability advocacy groups. Through hands‑on experience and discussion, drivers' ability to meet the boarding needs of persons with disabilities and respond to in‑bus sexual harassment incidents is improved. body:
The Hsinchu City Government held an event at the Hsinchu Bus Company's Niuwu repair workshop to promote wheelchair boarding assistance and anti‑sexual harassment protocols for bus drivers, in collaboration with five local bus operators and disability advocacy groups. Through hands‑on experience and discussion, drivers' ability to meet the boarding needs of persons with disabilities and respond to in‑bus sexual harassment incidents is improved. Mayor Hong‑an Gao explained the initiative focuses on role‑reversal experience to foster a safer, more inclusive public transport environment.

title: Taichung Extends Deadline for FY2026 Home Accessibility Improvement Subsidy to Oct 31
summary: Taichung City Housing Development Engineering Office continues the subsidy program for improving existing residential accessibility facilities, encouraging upgrades to pathways, ramps, handrails, and lifting equipment. The application period has been extended to October 31, with up to 45% subsidy of project costs, capped at NT$2.16 million, to improve accessibility, convenience, and safety for persons with disabilities, elderly, pregnant women, and families with strollers. Eligible buildings are those constructed before December 30, 2002 under the Housing Act, or legally built prior to building management implementation, with residential use ratio of at least 50%. Subsidy covers outdoor pathways of shared areas in apartment buildings, among other items.
body:
Taichung City Housing Development Engineering Office continues the subsidy program for improving existing residential accessibility facilities, encouraging upgrades to pathways, ramps, handrails, and lifting equipment. The application period has been extended to October 31, with up to 45% subsidy of project costs, capped at NT$2.16 million, to improve accessibility, convenience, and safety for persons with disabilities, elderly, pregnant women, and families with strollers. Eligible buildings are those constructed before December 30, 2002 under the Housing Act, or legally built prior to building management implementation, with residential use ratio of at least 50%. Subsidy covers outdoor pathways of shared areas in apartment buildings, among other items.

title: Taitung County Health Bureau Wins Six National Drug Administration Awards
summary: The Taitung County Health Bureau actively promoted drug administration affairs, implementing medication care, pharmacy barrier-free environment, and Chinese medicine management. In the 114th year national drug administration evaluation, it performed excellently and received six awards including the Medication Care Service Excellence Award, Pharmacy Barrier-Free Environment Excellence Award, Chinese Medicine Sampling Diligence Award, Chinese Medicine Inspection Performance Excellence Award, Chinese Medicine Violation Handling Excellence Award, and Chinese Medicine Business Evaluation Excellence Award. Bureau Director Sun Guo-ping went north to accept the award presented by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, affirming Taitung County's efforts and achievements in medication care, creating a friendly pharmacy environment, and ensuring Chinese medicine safety.
body:
The Taitung County Health Bureau actively promoted drug administration affairs, implementing medication care, pharmacy barrier-free environment, and Chinese medicine management. In the 114th year national drug administration evaluation, it performed excellently and received six awards including the Medication Care Service Excellence Award, Pharmacy Barrier-Free Environment Excellence Award, Chinese Medicine Sampling Diligence Award, Chinese Medicine Inspection Performance Excellence Award, Chinese Medicine Violation Handling Excellence Award, and Chinese Medicine Business Evaluation Excellence Award. Bureau Director Sun Guo-ping went north to accept the award presented by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, affirming Taitung County's efforts and achievements in medication care, creating a friendly pharmacy environment, and ensuring Chinese medicine safety.
